blocks.text: (Satellite image from Pagasa) MANILA, Philippines — The southwest monsoon or habagat will return over the western sections of the country on Saturday, bringing scattered rains to parts of Southern Luzon and the Visayas, the state weather bureau said. Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) weather specialist Loriedin De La Cruz-Galicia said the habagat will bring mostly cloudy skies and a high chance of rain over Occidental Mindoro, Palawan and Western Visayas. “The southwest monsoon is once again affecting the western sections of Southern Luzon and the Visayas.
